notes: PAP reference G44/0314. Whole three-room garden-level apartment facing Chartres station, with the garden side elevated to first-floor height because of the site's topography. The complete advert describes 82.05 m2 of habitable space comprising a 31 m2 air-conditioned living room, separate equipped kitchen, two air-conditioned bedrooms, bathroom, separate WC, entrance and hall. A 13.8 m2 terrace, 54.6 m2 private-use garden and one underground parking place are included; an optional double garage is separately priced and is not treated as part of the sale. The seller explicitly states immediate availability, PMR accessibility, reversible heat pump, DPE A/GES A, annual coproperty charges of EUR 1,788 and no current coproperty procedure. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or special-sale wording. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 10 September 2026. No elevator is asserted because the advert does not expose that fact.
